scope: Mechanical consistency only; no parameter optimisation, observation-model fitting, mobility, intervention coefficients, external datasets, or raw-OWID modification.
time_convention: Each row t after initialization is the interval-end state after [t-1,t]. The same beta scalar is used for the transition and recorded integrated flows: infections=S(t-1)-S(t), deaths=D(t)-D(t-1).

Rt_beta_interpretation.Rt_estimated: Cori renewal-ratio estimate treated as Reff only during calibration
Rt_beta_interpretation.beta: calibration beta(t)=Rt_estimated(t)*(gamma+mu)*N/S(t-1), held over [t-1,t]; validation beta is calibration-only median.

initial_conditions.initialization: E0 and I0 are reported-case windows; D0 is reported cumulative deaths; R0 is residual reported cumulative cases.
initial_conditions.limitation: These are surveillance proxies, not identified true infection compartments.

comparability.reason: No approved ascertainment or reporting-delay observation model.
Cumulative confirmed cases do not identify cumulative infections without ascertainment.
Death reporting delay is not identified and was not invented.
Supplementary only; retains reporting and IFR caveats.

descriptive_validation_metrics_not_case_.case_comparison_status: NOT IDENTIFIABLE: no ascertainment/reporting-delay observation model
descriptive_validation_metrics_not_case_.death_comparison_status: VALID WITH CAVEAT: no identified death-reporting delay
descriptive_validation_metrics_not_case_.cumulative_death_comparison_status: VALID WITH CAVEAT: supplementary trajectory only

limitation: No ascertainment rate or reporting delay was created; death lag was not selected or fitted.
